# Quiet Money

> The money rules nobody taught you. Short videos on money psychology and personal finance, each written out with its math and sources.

Educational content, not financial advice. Every number is computed; every story is sourced.

## Pages
- [Money Rules Library](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/): every video as a written page
- [Calculators](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/tools/): compound growth, credit card payoff, inflation
- [Free 7-day Money Reset](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/): printable checklist
- [About](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/about/): what Quiet Money is and how videos are made

## Money rules
- [Why Earning $300M Wasn't Enough to Save Him](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-earning-300m-wasn-t-enough-to-save-him/): Mike Tyson's 2003 bankruptcy filing is a classic case study of how a massive income cannot survive without a financial defense system. Wealth isn't what you earn—it is what you keep.
- [The $180 Stock That Made $7 Million](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-180-stock-that-made-7-million/): The true story of Grace Groner, a secretary who turned a $180 investment into $7 million through seventy-five years of pure patience.
- [The 4 Paths to Wealth (And Why Only 2 Set You Free)](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-4-paths-to-wealth-and-why-only-2-set-you-free/): Learn the four quadrants of money generation and why employees and self-employed professionals remain trapped. This breakdown explains the shift to business systems and investing to secure your exit from the rat race.
- [The 10,000 Shot Rule For Your First Customers](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-10-000-shot-rule-for-your-first-customers/): Learn the Rule of 100 framework to get your first customers through sheer volume and execution, plus the honest catch about startup failure rates.
- [The Exact Math To Quit Your Job Forever](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-exact-math-to-quit-your-job-forever/): Breaking down the exact math behind the 4% rule and how long it takes to build passive income that replaces a paycheck.
- [The Circle That Controls Your Net Worth](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-circle-that-controls-your-net-worth/): Your income and habits mirror the five people you talk to most. Audit your circle this week to break your financial ceiling.
- [The Secretary Who Quietly Built an $8.2M Fortune](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-secretary-who-quietly-built-an-8-2m-fortune/): Sylvia Bloom worked as a legal secretary for nearly seven decades and quietly amassed $8.2 million through steady, long-term investing in blue-chip stocks.
- [The exact number that buys your freedom](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-exact-number-that-buys-your-freedom/): Learn the exact math behind the 4% rule and passive income. See how much capital you need to replace your paycheck and escape the rat race.
- [Why Your House Isn't Actually an Asset](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-house-isn-t-actually-an-asset/): Robert Kiyosaki's rule flips conventional wisdom on your home. Learn why your house is a liability and how to focus on actual cash-flowing assets.
- [The Side Income Math That Replaces Your Paycheck](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-side-income-math-that-replaces-your-paycheck/): Learn how an extra $1,000 a month from a side business, when invested consistently for 10 years, builds the foundation to eventually replace your primary paycheck.
- [The 48-Hour Rule That Stops Impulse Buys](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-48-hour-rule-that-stops-impulse-buys/): Learn the simple 3-step wishlist trick that pauses emotional spending and keeps your hard-earned cash in your account.
- [Why 'Was $200, Now $99' Makes You Spend More](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-was-200-now-99-makes-you-spend-more/): Discover how the anchoring bias manipulates your spending habits through fake discounts and high initial price tags. Learn the simple counter-move to protect your wallet.
- [Why your brain treats tax refunds like free money](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-brain-treats-tax-refunds-like-free-money/): Mental accounting makes us waste tax refunds and bonuses on things we'd never buy with regular salary. Learn how to treat every dollar the same and build long-term wealth.
- [The 10-Year Delay That Costs $400,130](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-10-year-delay-that-costs-400-130/): This video breaks down the exact cost of waiting ten years to start investing. By comparing a 25-year-old and a 35-year-old both saving $200 a month at an 8% return, we show how a simple delay costs over $400,000 in compound interest.
- [The 10-Minute Money Setup You Need Today](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-10-minute-money-setup-you-need-today/): Learn the pay-yourself-first method and how automating your savings today builds massive long-term wealth without extra willpower.
- [Why Renting Isn't Throwing Money Away](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-renting-isn-t-throwing-money-away/): Deconstructing the myth that renting is always throwing money away by comparing ownership costs with market compounding.
- [Why a raise never makes you feel richer](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-a-raise-never-makes-you-feel-richer/): Lifestyle creep is the silent wealth killer that swallows every raise you get. Learn how to break the cycle and keep your hard-earned money working for you.
- [The $6,000 credit card mistake that takes 21 years](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-6-000-credit-card-mistake-that-takes-21-years/): Discover the hidden math behind paying only the minimum on a $6,000 credit card balance at 24% APR and how changing your monthly payment alters the timeline.
- [The Janitor Who Secretly Died With $8 Million](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-janitor-who-secretly-died-with-8-million/): Ronald Read worked as a gas station attendant and a janitor, lived frugally, and quietly built an almost $8 million fortune with boring dividend stocks he held for decades. The lesson: time beats salary.
